title: At-Tariq 86:9-12 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: At-Tariq 9 to 17, Al-Burooj 1 to 11 and stopping signs
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: At-Tariq 86:9-12 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 31. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ (٩) فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ (١٠) وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ (١١) وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ (١٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
Then man will have no power or any helper.
And [by] the earth which cracks open,

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into و

keywords.def: secrets, what is hidden in hearts

questions.q: Chunk and link At-Tariq 86:9-12 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 86:9-12 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 86:9-12 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
«ٱلصَّدْعِ»: the د is sakin, so it bounces.

questions.q: Why is «قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا» read with ghunnah but «مِن قُوَّةٍ» with ikhfa'?
questions.a: Tanween before و is idgham with ghunnah; noon before ق is ikhfa'.

questions.q: 86:10 says that on that Day a person has ...
questions.a: A) no power and no helper. 86:10: 'Then man will have no power or any helper.'

questions.q: At-Tariq 86:10: «فَمَا لَهُۥ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: On the Last Day every secret will be tested (86:9). Why should that make us careful even when no one is watching?
questions.a: Allah sees every secret; a believer does good in private as well as in public.
